method: Direct constant nodes and projection structure names. Named definitions are not unfolded.
selection: Three inspections of the same solution. The first requested 174 names, including all 155 route declarations, and found 171. The second added six declarations for independent comparison with compiled modules. The third requested 27 theta-related names and found 21, including one previously queried. Altogether 197 distinct declarations were read and nine requested names were absent. Source-file definitions may be absent from the published target export. Line numbers are one-based and byte offsets are zero-based in the unpacked solution.
